ms.report:
We received the CT comment: "The milestone acceptance criteria submitted by the team states that: ”At this point we expect high quality, readability, and usefulness from the generated docs. A general doc standard has been formed and new docs are using it, old docs are being updated to fit the standard.” However, after inspection of the littlefish knowledge base, we can say that this is not the case. Some of the 50 documents indeed adhere to a format and include a set structure, with chapters on the tool being presented; how the tool can be used; how can DAOs benefit from the tool; and how can DAOs use the tool, but a lot of them don’t, and also don’t adhere to the other metrics described in the SoM. Also our previous observation still applies: quite a few of them are bare bones and don’t really qualify as articles, as they are just a couple of paragraphs long and serve more as introductions to the specific tool or contain a slightly reworded description of the tool/service. In conclusion, we can't approve the milestone in its current form, but the team is definitely on the right track as quite a few of the articles can indeed be considered useful and of high-quality."

We have worked on improving our old documents according to our new standard. We have updated 25 old documents. We have structured, updated, and added new sections to our old documents. With addition of new documents, we now have 61 digital tool documents.

ms.promise:
The completion is the totality of all previous milestones. To summarize all those outputs:

1 - 10+ wallet deep dives + wallet comparison doc
2 - 50+ digital tool related docs
3 - 10+ Cardano DAO Tool deep dives 
4 - Cardano DAO Tools Map
5 - 5 Tools of DAO Work workshops
6 - littlefish Tools of Work 

Each defined with success criteria in previous milestones.The final output is a comprehensive knowledge base of documentation on the tools of decentralized work, specifically designed with the intention of answering critical questions communities/projects/DAOs in Cardano face: What tools do we need to use? When? Why? How?

This will give them the playbook, as it was created through actual use by an open source community driven project: littlefish Foundation. Take this up as you're starting your decentralized project, and find the answers to which tool to use for which scenario, how to use them effectively to drive community to Action, how organize human efforts towards common goals through the use of technology. 

We aim to have attestations to the benefit of the our product, as a display of success by this stage to show to the Cardano Community.
